name: LOVATO RGK600SA generator controller
summary: Panel-mounted stand-alone generator controller with a graphical display and speed-sensing interfaces.
description: Position the controller on the operator face and use the exact panel cutout from its dimensional drawing. Allow rear connector access and a route for generator sensing and engine-control wiring.
Use the linked manufacturer CAD for dimensions and the exact selected configuration. The downloadable illustration here is original educational geometry, unitless and not to scale.
readingNotes: The manufacturer identifies 12/24 V DC supply and W/pick-up speed inputs; record the selected wiring arrangement separately from the faceplate.
This stand-alone controller should not be represented as a generator paralleling controller.
drawingChecklist: Check the RGK600SA cutout and fastening parts.
Reserve rear connector and cable-loop space.
Cross-reference battery supply, sensing circuits and engine I/O.
distinction: This stand-alone controller should not be represented as a generator paralleling controller.
